name: io.github.paperoffice-ai/paperoffice-mcp
title: PaperOffice AI
description: Document AI and headless DMS: OCR, IDP, search, workflows, signatures. EU-hosted, OAuth 2.1.

lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/dms: Canonical Documents Operations catalog (14 tools + discovery). Default for generic MCP clients such as Claude Code, VS Code, Cline.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/cursor: Same catalog as /dms, tuned for Cursor and Windsurf. Also shipped as the paperoffice Cursor Marketplace plugin.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/claude: Anthropic Directory lane (Claude Desktop, claude.ai): business documents, no TTS.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/chatgpt: ChatGPT connector lane: 5 core tools + 4 discovery tools. Alias: /openai.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/grok: Grok custom connector lane, same catalog as /dms.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/mcp-full: Complete surface, 300+ API/MCP tools, for power users and agents.

authentication.oauth2: OAuth 2.1 with Client ID Metadata Documents; discovery at https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/{lane}
authentication.bearer: Authorization: Bearer <po_ut_… user token | po_gt_… group token>. System keys (po_sk_) and publishable keys (po_pk_) are rejected.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.hosting: EU Tier III data centers (Spain, Germany), own hardware, no third-party AI subprocessors
